scope: Compose init, match and seed per contact against immutable previous-frame topology and states
tolerance_reason: Outputs are integer decisions/IDs, copied state bits, constants and one f32 multiplication; all compare exactly. Pose arithmetic is internal to recycling decisions and is exercised around each decision boundary.
preconditions: Native Rust layouts and valid active references; old adjacency cumulative ends are monotone and IDs in bounds
Old and new state ranges are disjoint; inactive link body IDs need not be valid for match/seed
Finite active poses with unit quaternions, finite recycle limits; positive length unit and nonnegative distance
invariants: Only declared active fields change; readonly inputs, padding, state gaps and inactive lanes stay bitwise unchanged
First identity match in the shorter nonempty adjacency list; exact previous indices and color seeds
Multibody exclusion is retained even though articulated dynamics is deferred
Empty manifolds can retain invalid body and collider IDs; init, match and seed never dereference those IDs. Active manifold IDs remain validated.
outside_scope: Adjacency/color graph construction and conflict validation
